tool_input.command:
cd /tmp/scratch/research && g(){ mkdir -p "$1/$(dirname $3)"; curl -s "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/$2/HEAD/$3" > "$1/$3"; wc -wl "$1/$3"; }; 
for p in README.md CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md .claude-plugin/plugin.json hooks/hooks.json package.json; do g ECC affaan-m/ECC $p; done
python -I -c "
import json
t=json.load(open('ECC/tree.json'))['tree']
f=[x['path'] for x in t if x['type']=='blob']
import re
for p in f:
  if re.match(r'(hooks|rules/common|manifests|\.github/workflows)/',p) or re.match(r'agents/[^/]+\.md$',p) or re.match(r'commands/[^/]+\.md$',p) and False: print(p)
" | head -120
python -I -c "
import json
t=json.load(open('ECC/tree.json'))['tree']
f=[x['path'] for x in t if x['type']=='blob']
import re
print([p for p in f if re.match(r'skills/[^/]+/SKILL.md$',p)].__len__())
print([p.split('/')[1] for p in f if re.match(r'skills/[^/]+/SKILL.md$',p)][:400])
print([p for p in f if re.match(r'commands/[^/]+\.md$',p)][:120])
"
